name: Sputnik 1
notes: First artificial satellite (4 Oct 1957). Beeped for 21 days; reentered Jan 1958.

name: Explorer 1
notes: First US satellite; detected the Van Allen radiation belts.

name: Luna 2
notes: First human-made object to reach the Moon (impact 14 Sep 1959).

name: Luna 9
notes: First soft landing on the Moon and first photographs from its surface.

name: Venera 7
notes: First spacecraft to transmit data from the surface of another planet (Venus, 15 Dec 1970).

name: Mariner 10
notes: First probe to Mercury and first to use a gravity assist between planets.

name: Pioneer 10
notes: First spacecraft through the asteroid belt and to Jupiter; carries the Pioneer plaque. Last contact 2003.

name: Viking 1
notes: Orbiter plus lander; first successful Mars lander to operate for long periods (Jul 1976–Nov 1982).

name: Voyager 1
notes: Farthest human-made object; entered interstellar space Aug 2012. Carries the Golden Record.

name: Voyager 2
notes: Only spacecraft to visit Uranus and Neptune; entered interstellar space Nov 2018.

name: Hubble Space Telescope
notes: Launched on STS-31; serviced by five Shuttle missions.

name: Galileo
notes: First Jupiter orbiter and atmospheric probe; deliberately destroyed in Jupiter's atmosphere in 2003.

name: Cassini–Huygens
notes: Saturn orbiter and Titan lander (Huygens, 14 Jan 2005); ended with a plunge into Saturn on 15 Sep 2017.

name: New Horizons
notes: First flyby of Pluto (14 Jul 2015) and later Arrokoth.

name: Parker Solar Probe
notes: Fastest human-made object (~192 km/s at perihelion); flies through the solar corona.

name: James Webb Space Telescope
notes: 6.5 m infrared observatory at Sun–Earth L2, launched on Ariane 5.

name: Perseverance
notes: Mars rover that landed in Jezero crater 18 Feb 2021; carried the Ingenuity helicopter.

name: Europa Clipper
notes: Launched on Falcon Heavy (Oct 2024); en route to Jupiter for multiple Europa flybys.

name: Chang'e 6
notes: First sample return from the lunar far side (2024).

name: Luna 1
notes: First spacecraft to reach escape velocity; passed the Moon (Jan 1959) and entered solar orbit.

name: Luna 3
notes: Returned the first images of the Moon's far side (Oct 1959).

name: Luna 16
notes: First robotic lunar sample return (101 g from Mare Fecunditatis, Sep 1970).

name: Lunokhod 1
notes: First remote-controlled wheeled rover on another world; drove ~10.5 km in 11 months. Mass is the rover.

name: Ranger 7
notes: First US lunar impactor to succeed; returned 4,316 close-up images before impact.

name: Surveyor 1
notes: First US soft landing on the Moon (2 Jun 1966), a precursor to Apollo.

name: Mariner 2
notes: First successful interplanetary mission: Venus flyby, Dec 1962.

name: Mariner 4
notes: First Mars flyby (Jul 1965); returned the first close-up photographs of another planet.

name: Mariner 9
notes: First spacecraft to orbit another planet (Mars, Nov 1971); mapped the entire surface.

name: Venera 9
notes: First orbiter of Venus and first photographs from the surface of another planet (Oct 1975).

name: Mars 3
notes: First soft landing on Mars (2 Dec 1971); lander transmitted for only ~110 seconds.

name: Pioneer 11
notes: First flyby of Saturn (1979), after Jupiter in 1974. Carries the Pioneer plaque.

name: Giotto
notes: Flew within ~600 km of Halley's Comet nucleus (Mar 1986), then Grigg–Skjellerup.

name: Magellan
notes: Radar-mapped 98% of Venus; deliberately burned up in its atmosphere in 1994.

name: Ulysses
notes: First spacecraft to study the Sun at all latitudes from a polar orbit, using a Jupiter gravity assist.

name: NEAR Shoemaker
notes: First spacecraft to orbit and land on an asteroid (433 Eros, Feb 2001).

name: Mars Pathfinder
notes: Landed Jul 1997 with the Sojourner rover (10.5 kg), the first wheeled vehicle on Mars.

name: Mars Global Surveyor
notes: Mapped Mars from orbit for nine years; found gullies and past water evidence.

name: SOHO
notes: Solar observatory at Sun–Earth L1; discoverer of thousands of comets.

name: Chandra X-ray Observatory
notes: Launched on STS-93. Highly elliptical orbit reaching a third of the way to the Moon.

name: Stardust
notes: Returned dust from comet Wild 2 to Earth (Jan 2006), the first cometary sample return.

name: Hayabusa
notes: Landed on asteroid Itokawa and returned microscopic samples in 2010 despite multiple failures; ion-engine powered.

name: Mars Express
notes: ESA's first Mars orbiter; confirmed subsurface water ice. The Beagle 2 lander was lost on arrival.

name: Spirit (MER-A)
notes: Mars Exploration Rover in Gusev crater; mission planned for 90 sols, lasted until 2010. Mass is the rover.

name: Opportunity (MER-B)
notes: Operated on Meridiani Planum for 14+ years and ~45 km of driving. Mass is the rover.

name: Rosetta
notes: Orbited comet 67P/Churyumov–Gerasimenko; carried the Philae lander (~100 kg) which touched down Nov 2014.

name: MESSENGER
notes: First Mercury orbiter (2011–2015); mapped the entire planet then impacted the surface.

name: Deep Impact
notes: Fired an impactor into comet Tempel 1 (Jul 2005).

name: Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter
notes: HiRISE camera images the surface at ~30 cm resolution; relays for rovers.

name: Phoenix
notes: Landed in the Martian arctic (May 2008); confirmed water ice in the soil.

name: Dawn
notes: Ion-propelled; first spacecraft to orbit two extraterrestrial bodies (Vesta 2011, Ceres 2015).

name: Chandrayaan-1
notes: India's first lunar mission; its Moon Impact Probe and M3 instrument found water signatures.

name: Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter
notes: Mapping the Moon, including candidate Artemis landing sites and Apollo hardware.

name: Kepler
notes: Exoplanet transit survey that found thousands of planets; later flown as K2.

name: Akatsuki (Venus Climate Orbiter)
notes: Missed Venus orbit insertion in 2010 and succeeded in Dec 2015; observed atmospheric super-rotation.

name: Juno
notes: Jupiter polar orbiter since 2016; solar-powered. Extended mission status should be rechecked.

name: Curiosity (MSL)
notes: Mars rover in Gale crater since Aug 2012, delivered by the sky crane. Mass is the rover; launch mass 3,893 kg.

name: Chang'e 3 / Yutu
notes: China's first lunar soft landing (Dec 2013) with the Yutu rover.

name: Mars Orbiter Mission (Mangalyaan)
notes: India's first interplanetary mission; entered Mars orbit on its first attempt (Sep 2014), making India the first in Asia to do so.

name: Gaia
notes: Mapped ~1.5 billion stars in 3D at Sun–Earth L2; retired Mar 2025.

name: Hayabusa2
notes: Returned samples from asteroid Ryugu (Dec 2020); on extended mission to 1998 KY26.

name: OSIRIS-REx
notes: Delivered ~121.6 g from asteroid Bennu to Earth (Sep 2023); now flies as OSIRIS-APEX toward Apophis.

name: ExoMars Trace Gas Orbiter
notes: Measures trace atmospheric gases at Mars; relay orbiter. The Schiaparelli lander crashed in 2016.

name: TESS
notes: All-sky exoplanet transit survey in a lunar-resonant orbit.

name: InSight
notes: Mars seismology lander; detected hundreds of marsquakes before dust ended power in Dec 2022.

name: BepiColombo
notes: Two orbiters (MPO and Mio) for Mercury; scheduled to enter orbit in November 2026.

name: Chang'e 4 / Yutu-2
notes: First soft landing on the far side of the Moon (3 Jan 2019, Von Kármán crater), supported by the Queqiao relay.

name: Beresheet
notes: First privately funded lunar lander attempt; crashed on landing, Apr 2019.

name: Solar Orbiter
notes: Provides the first images of the Sun's poles; elliptical orbit reaching ~0.29 au.

name: Hope (Emirates Mars Mission)
notes: Mars atmospheric orbiter; the UAE's first interplanetary mission.

name: Tianwen-1 (Zhurong)
notes: China's first Mars mission: orbiter, lander and the Zhurong rover (landed May 2021, Utopia Planitia). Orbiter still active.

name: Ingenuity
notes: First powered, controlled flight on another planet (19 Apr 2021); 72 flights before rotor damage ended the mission in Jan 2024.

name: Lucy
notes: Visiting main-belt asteroid Dinkinesh and the Jupiter Trojans through 2033.

name: DART
notes: First planetary defense test: struck asteroid Dimorphos on 26 Sep 2022, changing its orbit by ~33 minutes.

name: Danuri (KPLO)
notes: South Korea's first lunar orbiter; launched on Falcon 9 via a ballistic lunar transfer.

name: Chandrayaan-3 (Vikram / Pragyan)
notes: India's first lunar landing (23 Aug 2023), near the south pole; the lander and its rover completed a lunar day of operations.

name: Luna 25
notes: Russia's first lunar mission since 1976; crashed Aug 2023 after an orbit-lowering error.

name: SLIM
notes: Pinpoint lunar lander (Jan 2024); touched down within metres of target but on its nose.

name: Psyche
notes: Solar-electric spacecraft heading to metal-rich asteroid 16 Psyche, arrival 2029.

name: JUICE
notes: Heading to Jupiter's moons Ganymede, Callisto and Europa; arrival 2031.

name: Odysseus (IM-1)
notes: First commercial soft landing on the Moon (22 Feb 2024); tipped over near the south pole but returned data.

name: Blue Ghost Mission 1
notes: Completed a fully successful lunar landing in Mare Crisium (Mar 2025) and operated through a lunar day.
